name: playwright-lm-tools
description: Browser automation tools (pw_*) for GitHub Copilot agent mode via the native VS Code Language Model Tool API. Drives local Edge/Chrome with playwright-core (channel mode, no browser download, no MCP).

pwTools.channel.description: 使用本机哪个浏览器(playwright channel)。首选项启动失败时会自动尝试另一个。

pwTools.headless.description: 无头模式运行浏览器。默认 false,方便观察 agent 的操作过程。

pwTools.snapshotMaxChars.description: 返回给模型的无障碍树快照最大字符数,超出部分截断。设为 0 表示不限制。

pwTools.navigationTimeoutMs.description: pw_navigate / pw_back 的导航超时(毫秒)。CI 等慢环境可调大。

pwTools.actionTimeoutMs.description: 点击、输入等元素动作的超时(毫秒)。

pwTools.screenshotOnVerifyFail.description: pw_verify 断言失败时自动截图取证。

pwTools.stateDir.description: pw_save_state / pw_load_state 的存储目录。留空则使用工作区下的 .pw-state/。

languageModelTools.name: pw_navigate
languageModelTools.userDescription: 在受控浏览器中打开 URL(首次调用会启动本机 Edge/Chrome)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate the controlled browser to a URL. The local Edge/Chrome browser is launched automatically on first use. Returns the final URL, the page title and an accessibility snapshot of the page. Interactive elements in the snapshot carry refs like [ref=e12]; pass those refs to pw_click / pw_type.

url.description: The URL to open, e.g. https://example.com. 'https://' is assumed when the scheme is missing.

languageModelTools.name: pw_snapshot
languageModelTools.userDescription: 抓取当前页面的无障碍树快照(含元素 ref)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Capture a text accessibility-tree snapshot of the current page. Interactive elements are annotated with refs like [ref=e12] which pw_click / pw_type accept. Prefer this over pw_screenshot for reading page content or locating elements. Refs go stale when the page changes — take a fresh snapshot before interacting if in doubt.

languageModelTools.name: pw_click
languageModelTools.userDescription: 点击页面元素(按快照中的 ref)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Click an element on the current page, identified by its ref from the most recent snapshot (returned by pw_snapshot, pw_navigate, pw_click or pw_type). Returns a fresh snapshot after the click. If the ref is reported stale, call pw_snapshot first and retry with a new ref.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. 'e12'.

element.description: Short human-readable description of the element, e.g. 'Login button'. Shown to the user in the tool-call UI.

languageModelTools.name: pw_type
languageModelTools.userDescription: 向输入框输入文本(按快照中的 ref)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Type text into an editable element identified by its ref from the most recent snapshot. By default the field is cleared and filled in one shot; set slowly=true to type character by character (for pages reacting to each keystroke), and submit=true to press Enter afterwards. Returns a fresh snapshot.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. 'e12'.

element.description: Short human-readable description of the element, e.g. 'Search box'.

submit.description: Press Enter after typing (submits most forms).

slowly.description: Type one character at a time instead of filling at once.

languageModelTools.name: pw_screenshot
languageModelTools.userDescription: 截取当前页面截图(PNG)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Take a PNG screenshot of the current page and save it to a temp file. Returns the file path, and the image itself when the editor supports inline image tool results. Use pw_snapshot instead when you need to read text or find elements — the accessibility snapshot is cheaper and machine-readable.

fullPage.description: Capture the full scrollable page instead of just the viewport.

languageModelTools.name: pw_wait
languageModelTools.userDescription: 等待固定时长或等待文本出现
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Wait for a fixed number of seconds, or wait until the given text becomes visible on the page, or both (text with a timeout). Provide at least one of 'seconds' and 'text'. Seconds are capped at 30. Returns a fresh snapshot afterwards.

seconds.description: How long to wait, in seconds (max 30). When 'text' is also given, this is the wait timeout.

text.description: Wait until this text is visible on the page.

languageModelTools.name: pw_close
languageModelTools.userDescription: 关闭受控浏览器
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Close the controlled browser and release its resources. Call this when the browsing task is finished. The next pw_navigate will start a fresh browser.

languageModelTools.name: pw_verify
languageModelTools.userDescription: 断言页面状态,返回确定性的 PASS/FAIL
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Assert the state of the current page and get a deterministic PASS/FAIL verdict. assertion='text_visible' checks the given text is visible on the page; 'element_visible' checks the element with the given ref is visible; 'value' compares an input element's current value against 'expected'. On FAIL a screenshot is attached automatically (configurable). ALWAYS use this tool for test conclusions instead of judging from snapshots.

text.description: For text_visible: the text expected to be visible.

ref.description: For element_visible / value: element ref from the latest snapshot.

element.description: Short human-readable description of the element.

expected.description: For value: the expected input value.

languageModelTools.name: pw_console
languageModelTools.userDescription: 读取浏览器控制台消息与页面错误
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the browser console messages and uncaught page errors recorded since the browser started (ring buffer, all tabs). Set onlyErrors=true to see only errors; clear=true empties the buffer after reading. Use when diagnosing why a page or test step failed.

onlyErrors.description: Only return error-level messages and uncaught exceptions.

languageModelTools.name: pw_handle_dialog
languageModelTools.userDescription: 处理当前挂起的 JS 弹窗(alert/confirm/prompt)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Handle the currently open JavaScript dialog (alert/confirm/prompt). While a dialog is open the page is blocked and other tools refuse to run. accept=true confirms it (optionally typing promptText into a prompt); accept=false dismisses it. Returns a fresh snapshot afterwards.

accept.description: true to accept/confirm, false to dismiss/cancel.

promptText.description: Text to enter when accepting a prompt dialog.

languageModelTools.name: pw_select_option
languageModelTools.userDescription: 在原生下拉框中选择选项(按 ref)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Select one or more options in a native <select> dropdown identified by its snapshot ref. Each value is matched against the visible option label first, then against the option's value attribute. Returns a fresh snapshot. For custom (non-<select>) dropdowns, use pw_click on the option's own ref instead.

ref.description: Element ref of the <select> from the latest snapshot.

values.description: Option labels (as shown in the snapshot) or value attributes to select.

languageModelTools.name: pw_press_key
languageModelTools.userDescription: 按下键盘按键或组合键
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Press a keyboard key or shortcut, e.g. 'Escape', 'Tab', 'Enter', 'ArrowDown', 'Control+A'. When ref is given the key is sent to that element (it is focused first); otherwise it goes to the page. Returns a fresh snapshot.

ref.description: Optional element ref to receive the key.

element.description: Short description of the target element, if ref is given.

languageModelTools.name: pw_hover
languageModelTools.userDescription: 悬停在页面元素上(如展开悬停菜单)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Hover the mouse over an element identified by its snapshot ref — e.g. to reveal a hover menu or tooltip. Returns a fresh snapshot that includes any newly revealed content.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot.

element.description: Short human-readable description of the element.

languageModelTools.name: pw_upload
languageModelTools.userDescription: 向文件输入框上传本地文件
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set files on a file input identified by its snapshot ref. Paths must be absolute paths to existing local files. If the ref is a button that opens a file chooser rather than an <input type=file>, the chooser is intercepted automatically. Returns a fresh snapshot.

ref.description: Element ref of the file input or the button that opens the chooser.

element.description: Short human-readable description of the element.

paths.description: Absolute paths of local files to upload.

languageModelTools.name: pw_network
languageModelTools.userDescription: 查看记录的网络请求与响应
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the network requests recorded since the browser started (id, method, status, URL), optionally filtered by a URL substring. Pass 'id' to get one request's details, including content type and a response-body snippet for text/JSON responses. Use to verify API calls and diagnose 4xx/5xx failures.

urlFilter.description: Only list requests whose URL contains this substring.

id.description: Return full details for the request with this id.

languageModelTools.name: pw_save_state
languageModelTools.userDescription: 保存登录态(cookies + localStorage)到文件
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Save the browser's storage state (cookies + localStorage — e.g. a login session) to a named file under the workspace's .pw-state directory. The standard testing pattern: log in once interactively, save the state, then restore it with pw_load_state in later runs instead of logging in again.

languageModelTools.name: pw_load_state
languageModelTools.userDescription: 恢复之前保存的登录态
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restore a storage state previously saved with pw_save_state. A fresh browser context is created with those cookies/localStorage; navigate to the app afterwards — the saved login should be in effect.

name.description: State name used at save time, default 'default'.

languageModelTools.name: pw_resize
languageModelTools.userDescription: 调整浏览器视口尺寸(响应式测试)
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resize the browser viewport to the given width and height in pixels (100-5000). Use for responsive-layout testing, e.g. 375x812 for mobile. Returns a fresh snapshot of the re-laid-out page.

languageModelTools.name: pw_scroll
languageModelTools.userDescription: 滚动页面或滚动到指定元素
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Scroll the page. With ref: scroll that element into view. Without ref: scroll the page up/down by 'pixels' (default 720). Use to trigger lazy-loaded content or reach off-screen elements. Returns a fresh snapshot.

direction.description: Scroll direction when no ref is given (default down).

pixels.description: How far to scroll in pixels (default 720).

ref.description: Element ref to scroll into view.

element.description: Short description of the target element, if ref is given.

languageModelTools.name: pw_back
languageModelTools.userDescription: 返回浏览历史的上一页
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Navigate back to the previous page in the browser history. Returns a fresh snapshot, or a notice when there is no history to go back to.
